description: 21KRAFT : Your Gateway to Luxury Travel in the Indian Subcontinent Every great journey begins with a story. At 21Kraft, ours is rooted in an ancient Indian belief— “Atithi Devo Bhava” —the guest is God . This philosophy guides everything we do, shaping journeys that are more than itineraries; they are carefully woven tapestries of culture, indulgence, and unforgettable moments. From our base in New Delhi, we open the doors to India and its neighboring lands—Nepal, Bhutan, Sri Lanka, and the Maldives—designing experiences that blend the grandeur of heritage with the elegance of modern luxury. Imagine waking up in a centuries-old palace once reserved for royalty, embarking on a sunrise yoga session overlooking the Himalayas, or dining under the stars as the desert sands shift in Rajasthan. Picture an evening cruise on a private yacht in the Maldives, or a silent walk through ancient temples where spirituality is almost tangible. These are not packages. They are stories—crafted with care, precision, and an intimate understanding of what luxury truly means. Our role is simple: to listen, to curate, and to deliver. Whether it’s a family seeking cultural immersion, a corporate group in need of flawless execution, or a discerning traveler craving exclusivity, we orchestrate every detail. Our multilingual guides bring destinations alive with narratives that transcend guidebooks, while our operations team ensures seamless logistics—luxury transfers, curated stays, and every indulgence in between. Behind the scenes, quality checks and trusted partnerships guarantee a journey that is effortless, secure, and world-class. And because the most precious luxury is time, our concierge team works around the clock—turning last-minute wishes into flawless realities. At the heart of 21Kraft are our 21 Signature Journeys —a collection of experiences designed to celebrate India’s spirit in all its colors: cultural immersions at festivals and royal palaces, spiritual retreats in serene landscapes, thrilling adventures across mountains and deserts, and indulgent escapes aboard luxury trains or private cruises. Each journey is a story waiting to be lived, remembered, and retold. 21Kraft isn’t just a travel company. We are storytellers, curators, and custodians of experiences that linger long after the journey ends. For those who seek more than travel—for those who seek meaning, beauty, and wonder—we are your trusted gateway to the Indian subcontinent.

Abercrombie & Kent is an award-winning, luxury travel company with a difference. We’re not like most other travel companies, and we couldn’t be more different from those baffling booking sites. There’s nothing DIY about A&K. Our holidays aren't packaged or off-the-rack. We create tailor-made escapes. Each holiday as individual as the person it is created for. We care – not only about your holiday, but also about the world we’re all travelling through*. We’re dab hands – we're experts who have been helping travellers explore and discover for more than 60 years. Just like you, we’ve got a bad case of wanderlust. We’re here to guide and inspire you, to help you push the boundaries of your comfort zone, and take you off-the-beaten-track. We’ll ensure that your time away is the time of your life. A&K is part of the A&K Travel Group, a global lifestyle and travel company that sets the standard for refined and personalised travel experiences. These include Abercrombie & Kent, Crystal, and Cox & Kings.

Tailor-made holidays and safaris, crafted by experts Audley Travel is a tour operator with more than 25 years’ experience in creating meaningful travel experiences shaped around you.​ Audley has come a long way from its beginnings as a tiny start-up, offering a new, personal style of travel. Today, we offer trips to destinations worldwide, but we still hold to our founding belief that travel means the most when it’s created for you. ​ A trip with Audley is created completely around you, from the experiences you have to the places you stay. Covering over 90 countries, Audley’s award-winning specialists have a deep connection to their destinations that can only have come from living or travelling there extensively. By understanding the meaning behind why you want to travel, they can create experiences that will change your perspective and stay with you long after you’ve returned home.​

Authentic India Tours is a specialist tour operator offering ABTA protected tailor-made and small group tours of India, Nepal, Bhutan, Sri Lanka and the Maldives. Our team, which is largely based in the region, spend time sourcing the best accommodation and experiences available and developing creative itineraries designed to give you an extra special holiday experience with an ‘authentic’ feel that we know you’ll love. Our itineraries typically range from 6 to 24 days staying in hand-picked accommodation featuring boutique and heritage hotels, luxury resorts as well as wonderful safari lodges and desert camps. This area offers a multitude of truly memorable holiday options where you can enjoy a range of amazing experiences. From exploring World Heritage Sites to trekking the Himalayas, discovering vibrant cities or relaxing on a private houseboat in the tranquil backwaters, experiencing the adventure of game safaris in National Parks or relishing time on a sun-drenched beach, the possibilities are endless. If you’re looking to see the region a little differently, our cycling, trekking, cookery, birdwatching and well-being tours also enable you to pursue a passion. Whatever your interests our travel experts are here to help you discover the magic of this region with a truly memorable holiday.

Baltic Holidays are experts in tailor-made travel to the Baltic states of Lithuania, Latvia & Estonia, the Nordic countries & Eastern Europe. For over 26 years we have been creating unique itineraries for our guests. Our exceptionally high standards and attention to detail set us aside from the rest; we use handpicked hotels, the very best local partners, and design your tour to suit you. Our guests receive a warm welcome and experience the very best of our destinations; brought to life by meeting local people and hearing their stories. Our local guides are exceptional. Our private tours are designed to suit your pace and interests, staying at characterful Old Town hotels, with private transfers, walking tours, and excursions all exclusively for you. Tailor your tour by adding Michelin restaurant reservations, concert tickets, a bog walk in a national park, or overnight in a rural manor house or spa hotel - we love to make things happen. Two of our managing partners are authors of the new Bradt guide to Lithuania (Sally & Linas). Baltic Holidays have been awarded the Tripadvisor Travellers' Choice Award for the third year running in 2026. We would be delighted to meet you at the fair.

Welcome to CapoSperone Resort , an exclusive Mediterranean retreat in southern Italy set within a unique natural landscape where Calabria blends with Sicily. Nestled on a rocky spur covered in Mediterranean scrub and overlooking the legendary seas of the Odyssey with breathtaking views on the Purple Coast, the Coast of Gods, the Aeolian Islands, and the Strait of Messina, CapoSperone is an intense sensorial experience in an enchanted area described in the diaries of travellers Edward Lear and Alexandre Dumas and once belonging to Magna Graecia .

Hebridean Island Cruises - Where Small Means Personal Hebridean Island Cruises is perhaps one of the world’s most unusual cruise companies – our recipe for holidays afloat is simple – we create unique experiences for few a people and never something ordinary for a crowd. We have flown in the face of current fashion by only ever operating small ships. Whilst today’s mega-vessels may suit the mass market, there will always be a place for ships that are small and personal. Our fleet comprises of just 3 ships - Hebridean Island Cruises, Lord of the Highlands and Lord of the Glens – each dedicated to providing the finest holidays afloat around the Western Isles of Scotland and The Caledonian Canal – and all providing an extraordinary level of service that is the hallmark of Hebridean Island Cruises. Whatever your choice from our range of cruises, they all include fascinating shore excursions, always organised with precision and often to places accessible only to private yachts. And when back on board our chefs create imaginative menus using the freshest ingredients available.

Hebrides Cruises is an award-winning, family-run small ship cruise company offering unforgettable journeys through Scotland’s spectacular Hebridean islands and remote west coast. Based in Oban, our family has spent decades exploring these extraordinary waters, sharing our passion for the wildlife, landscapes, culture and communities of the Hebrides with guests from around the world. Today, Hebrides Cruises remains proudly independent and family owned, with three small ships offering an intimate and highly personal cruising experience. With just a small number of guests onboard, every voyage is different. Our flexible itineraries allow us to follow wildlife sightings, take advantage of favourable weather and tides, and discover hidden anchorages and places larger ships simply cannot reach. From whales and dolphins to sea eagles, puffins and otters, the natural world is at the heart of what we do. Exceptional hospitality, locally inspired cuisine and knowledgeable guides combine with the warmth of a family business to create truly memorable holidays. Whether exploring iconic islands such as Mull, Iona and Skye or venturing to Scotland’s most remote shores, we offer authentic, immersive luxury experiences in one of the world’s most beautiful and unspoilt destinations.

Heritage Wine Tours crafts bespoke private wine journeys through luxury French wine regions; Bordeaux, Burgundy, Champagne, the Rhône, and Beaujolais. Led by father-daughter duo Emily and John, our itineraries are supported by Emily's WSET-honed expertise and our connections with local guides, built up over years. As an independent, family-run company, we take the time to shape each itinerary around the person taking it. Every journey is fully bespoke, built around the traveller's pace and palate, and handled start to finish: private transport, curated tastings at hidden gems and iconic estates alike, and hand-picked dining and hotel recommendations. No two itineraries look the same.

Hogan Holidays is a boutique luxury travel specialist creating exceptional tailor-made escapes across Europe and beyond. From iconic grand hotels to hidden gem retreats, we craft personalised journeys with authentic experiences, seamless service, and a meticulous eye for detail. Our passion is simple: to turn every trip into a story worth telling.

Humboldt Travel is a small luxury operator owned by husband-and-wife team Simon and Kirsty Williams. We specialise in luxury, tailor-made holidays to Latin America, Asia and Africa. Using our extensive black book of local contacts, we craft exceptional trips and luxury experiences, working with you to create your dream journey. For everyone who travels with us, we donate to our chosen charity within that country. This enables local community projects to pay for things like children’s schooling in Peru, a health project in South Africa or a women’s co-operative in India. For us this is also about inspiring our guests, so that they return home full of knowledge and enthusiasm for the country they’ve visited, the wildlife they’ve seen and the people they’ve encountered. We firmly believe that when travel is done right it can create such a positive impact. We’re an independent company and because of this each booking is very important to us. You’re not just a number in a sales target. We are ATOL bonded and members of the Travel Trust Association which guarantees full financial protection for your holiday. We want every client to have the best holiday possible which means you receive a very personal service.

Every itinerary is thoughtfully designed, blending Morocco’s beauty, culture, and soul into a seamless experience created just for you. What sets us apart is our devotion to both our travelers and our country. We partner with local communities, guides, and artisans, ensuring every journey is meaningful, sustainable, and respectful. Luxury, for us, is not only found in a five-star riad or a private desert camp — it’s also in the stories shared over tea, the hidden paths revealed, and the connections made along the way. Morocco, like never before.

PONANT EXPLORATIONS invites discerning travellers to discover the world through a distinctive combination of exploration, French savoir-faire and exceptional small-ship experiences. With a proud British heritage and a truly international outlook, Swan Hellenic offers a sophisticated way to explore – where wildlife encounters, ancient cultures, remarkable landscapes and fascinating science become part of an unforgettable journey. Swan Hellenic – cultural expedition cruising for curious travellers who want to see more, experience more and go beyond.

description: WE ARE LOOKING FORWARD TO MEETING YOU AT THE LUXURY TRAVEL SHOW AND TALKING ABOUT YOUR AFRICA! CAN'T WAIT UNTIL NOVEMBER? THEN CALL US ON 01984 667420 OR EMAIL SUE@TRACKSSAFARIS.CO.UK - BEAT THE JANUARY RUSH AND BOOK NOW! Tracks Safaris are ATOL bonded and members of the Travel Trust Association for your complete financial protection and peace of mind! Tracks Safaris are African wildlife and safari specialists creating extraordinary wildlife experiences which benefit local communities, conservation and wildlife. We also offer wildlife experiences to the Indian Subcontinent, Sri Lanka, the Indian Ocean, and the Pantanal in Brazil. Wildlife is our passion and we have explored the countries we operate in extensively. We have stayed at the camps and lodges, slept in the beds, eaten the food, been on safari with the local guides and experienced the wildlife and habitats. There are not many other ways we could have experienced Africa - we have flown in light aircraft, hot air balloons and microlights, kayaked, canoed and floated by mokoro in Africa's rivers, deltas and waterways, driven across the plains, deserts and deltas in Africa's National Parks and reserves, explored her rainforests, swam, dived and sailed in the surrounding oceans. We have walked, trekked, hiked and climbed, ridden on horseback, camel and donkey. We have explored the areas you want to see! Tracks safaris are passionate about wildlife holidays and our website is your introduction to the destinations we offer and the services we provide – browse through the pages and then contact us to create your perfect travel experience. Whether you are looking for a lodge safari, a tented safari, a self drive safari, a mobile safari, a walking safari, a flying safari, or a safari for the whole family, let us give you some ideas and inspiration. If you love photography and would like to improve your wildlife and landscape photographic skills - Africa is the perfect destination to do this. We have photographic safaris all over Africa - just give us a ring. We can arrange wedding safaris, honeymoon safaris, small group safaris, tailor-made safaris, specialist safaris for those interested in birds or specific mammals such as lion or wild dog – in fact we can arrange just about any safari just for you. Combine your safari with a few days on the beach – treat yourself to a pampering break or some diving and snorkelling in crystal waters on the Kenya Coast, Zanzibar, South Africa or Mozambique – the perfect antidote to follow your African adventure! If you are interested in conservation, have a look at our Conservation experiences. Combine a traditional safari whilst experiencing the thrill of participating in leopard conservation in South Africa, lion and rhino conservation in Kenya. Alternatively, work on a voluntary basis with cheetahs in Namibia. Whatever you are looking for we aim to bring you an authentic, unforgettable safari experience. Going on safari on your own? We can track down the best safaris for you with no single supplement! Or take a look at our 'Ladies Only Safaris' offering the chance to safari in Kenya, Tanzania and India with a small group of ladies also interested in wildlife and birds. Tracks Safaris have all the latest special offers from the leading safari operators - tell us where you want to go and what you want to see and we will do the rest! Tracks Safaris are committed to the concept of responsible travel and believe passionately that travel should benefit the host communities and be beneficial to local economies and environment. WHY BOOK WITH TRACKS SAFARIS ATOL Protected Everyone wants to know that their holiday is completely safe once they have booked it. Tracks Safaris are fully bonded by ATOL operate a Trust Account with the Travel Trust Association which offers our clients 100% financial protection and peace of mind. African Specialists Tracks Safaris are African specialists and are continuously travelling to the areas that you want to visit inspecting accommodation and experiencing the product first hand. We travel around 4 or 5 times a year for around 2/3 weeks each time – so that is around 12 weeks every year for 15 years! We really know Africa! Owner Managed Tracks Safaris is owner managed and we are totally independent. We will always recommend the best option for your safari and we most likely will have stayed at the camps and lodges and experienced the wildlife before we recommend it to you. You will talk to the same professional, friendly African Travel Expert every time. We offer our clients a level of service seldom found elsewhere: indeed it is our priority to ensure the perfect safari for each and every guest. Community Support Tracks Safaris are passionate about ‘putting back’ to both local communities and wildlife organisations in the countries we operate in. We donate at least $10 for every booking to one of our charities and also monitor our suppliers to ensure they are supporting local communities and conservation too. Additionally we support a number of disadvantaged girls through their education in Uganda! Family Safaris Tracks Safaris have extensive knowledge and experience of travelling with children of all ages and we use that experience to tailor make your family an itinerary which is well paced and child or teen friendly. Multi generational safaris are our speciality and we would be delighted to assist you with your family safari planning.
